films.title: Maria Full of Grace
films.overview: A pregnant Colombian teenager becomes a drug mule to make some desperately needed money for her family.

films.title: New York, I Love You
films.overview: New York, I Love You delves into the intimate lives of New Yorkers as they grapple with, delight in and search for love. Journey from the Diamond District in the heart of Manhattan, through Chinatown and the Upper East Side, towards the Village, into Tribeca, and Brooklyn as lovers of all ages try to find romance in the Big Apple.

films.title: Complete Unknown
films.overview: Tom’s birthday dinner party is turned upside down by the unexpected arrival of Alice, an old flame who changed her identity and vanished without a trace 15 years prior.

films.title: Come Sunday
films.overview: Evangelist Carlton Pearson is ostracized by his church for preaching that there is no Hell.
